name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
description: Larsen & Toubro Ltd (L&T) is India's multinational engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) conglomerate. company_profile.summary: Larsen & Toubro Ltd (L&T) is India's multinational engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) conglomerate. Operating in over 50 countries, L&T builds critical infrastructure across transportation, clean energy, hydrocarbons, heavy civil bridges, defense systems, IT services (LTIMindtree), and data centers.

revenue_breakup.desc: High-speed rail, metro corridors, expressways, thermal/hydro plants, and water treatment.
Digital transformation, cloud engineering, and ER&D software for global industrial enterprises.
Offshore platforms, refineries, LNG terminals, and green hydrogen electrolysers.
Nuclear reactor pressure vessels, submarine hulls, artillery systems (K9 Vajra), and aerospace structures.
Retail two-wheeler loans, farm equipment loans, and micro-loans.
Hyderabad Metro rail operations and power transmission concessions.

moats_and_strengths: Colossal order book exceeding ₹4.75 Lakh Cr with 2.8x book-to-bill providing multi-year revenue visibility.
Only Indian EPC firm capable of executing mega-scale national projects (e.g. Mumbai Coastal Road, Bullet Train).
Dominant supplier of critical equipment to India's space (ISRO) and defense (DRDO) strategic programs.
Strong balance sheet enabling the company to underwrite multi-billion-dollar international mega-tenders.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Consolidated Order Book: ₹4,90,000 Cr+ ($58B+) • High order intake from Saudi Aramco & GCC energy projects

promoter_governance.parent_group: Professionally Managed (L&T Employees Trust & Public Institutions)

bullish_triggers: Unprecedented capex upcycle across the Gulf Cooperation Council (Saudi Aramco Namaat, UAE ADNOC expansions).
Execution ramp-up of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail and Dedicated Freight Corridors in India.
Commercialization of green hydrogen electrolyser giga-factory in Hazira, Gujarat.
bearish_risks: Geopolitical volatility in the Middle East impacting project commissioning timelines.
Raw material inflation in structural steel, cement, and copper compressing fixed-price EPC contracts.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)

faqs.question: What is the MTF margin required to trade Larsen & Toubro Ltd (LT) on NSE?
faqs.answer: Larsen & Toubro Ltd (LT) is approved under SEBI's Margin Trading Facility (MTF) with an initial maintenance margin requirement of approximately 20%. This enables swing traders to access 5.0x purchasing power on eligible Indian brokerage platforms.
